summary: Iteration 129: TRMM Broadcast Notifications (Slack/Teams) - All 37 tests PASSED. Verified all new notification endpoints: GET /api/trmm/notifications/settings returns default shape {slack_webhook_url:'', teams_webhook_url:'', notify_on:'all', include_per_agent:true, configured:false}. POST /api/trmm/notifications/settings returns 400 for invalid notify_on, saves successfully with valid Slack/Teams URLs. POST /api/trmm/notifications/test returns 400 when no webhook configured, returns {success:true, results:[{target:'slack', status:200, ok:true}]} with httpbin.org/post. E2E: broadcast completion populates 'notifications' field and 'notified_at' timestamp. notify_on='none' skips notification. notify_on='failures' with failures sends notification. All regression tests for iterations 122-128 pass.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/trmm/notifications/settings: Returns default shape when nothing saved (correct)
POST /api/trmm/notifications/settings: Returns 400 when notify_on not in (all|failures|none) (correct)
POST /api/trmm/notifications/settings: Saves successfully with valid Slack URL; subsequent GET shows configured:true (correct)
POST /api/trmm/notifications/settings: Saves successfully with valid Teams URL (correct)
POST /api/trmm/notifications/test: Returns 400 'No webhook configured' when neither URL set (correct)
POST /api/trmm/notifications/test with target='slack': Returns {success:true, results:[{target:'slack', status:200, ok:true}]} with httpbin (correct)
POST /api/trmm/notifications/test with target='teams': Returns {success:true, results:[{target:'teams', status:200, ok:true}]} with httpbin (correct)
POST /api/trmm/notifications/test with target='both': Fires both if configured (correct)
POST /api/trmm/notifications/test with partial success: Returns {success:false,...} with per-target breakdown (correct)
E2E broadcast with notification: db.trmm_broadcasts gets 'notifications' field and 'notified_at' timestamp (correct)
E2E with notify_on='none': Broadcast completes but notifications NOT set (correct)
E2E with notify_on='failures' and failed_count>0: Notification IS sent (correct)
All endpoints require authentication (401/403 without token)
Regression: All TRMM endpoints from iterations 122-128 still pass
httpbin.org/post used as public sink to validate webhook delivery without real Slack/Teams credentials
seed_data_creation: Test broadcasts and notification settings created during testing; cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All notification endpoints verified working. GET /api/trmm/notifications/settings returns default shape when nothing saved. POST /api/trmm/notifications/settings saves Slack/Teams webhook URLs with notify_on (all|failures|none). POST /api/trmm/notifications/test sends test notification to configured webhooks. After broadcast completion, _send_broadcast_notification() is called which populates 'notifications' and 'notified_at' fields in db.trmm_broadcasts. notify_on='none' skips notification entirely. notify_on='failures' only sends if failed_count>0. httpbin.org/post is used as a public 200-returning sink for testing webhook delivery.
mocked_api_note: httpbin.org/post is used as a real public HTTP endpoint (NOT a mock) to validate Slack/Teams webhook delivery. It returns 200 for any POST request, simulating successful webhook delivery without requiring real Slack/Teams credentials.
